met_analysis:
The Low Pressure area over northwest Madhya Pradesh & adjoining southwest Uttar Pradesh lies over Southwest Uttar Pradesh & neighbourhood at 0530 hrs IST of today, the 06th September 2026. The associated cyclonic circulation extends upto 5.8 km above mean sea level. It is likely to move east-northeastwards during next 24 hours.
The Monsoon trough at mean sea level now passes through Sri Ganganagar, Delhi, centre of Low Pressure area over Southwest Uttar Pradesh & neighbourhood, Satna, Daltonganj, Bankura and thence eastwards towards Tripura.
The trough now runs from South Haryana to south Assam now runs from Northeast Rajasthan to south Assam across the cyclonic circulation associated with Low Pressure area over Southwest Uttar Pradesh & neighbourhood, north Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, south Bihar and northern part of Gangetic West Bengal and extends upto 1.5 km above mean sea level.
The trough now runs from south Gujarat to north Bangladesh across cyclonic circulation associated with Low Pressure area over Southwest Uttar Pradesh & neighbourhood, north Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand and West Bengal between 3.1 & 5.8 km above mean sea level.
The Western Disturbance now seen as a trough in middle tropospheric westerlies with its axis at 5.8 km above mean sea level roughly along Long. 70°E to the north of Lat. 28°N.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over northeast Assam & neighbourhood extending upto 1.5 km above mean sea level persists.
The trough from south Telangana to Gulf of Mannar across Rayalaseema and Tamil Nadu at 0.9 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over north Coastal Andhra Pradesh & Yanam & Westcentral Bay of Bengal at 7.6 km above mean sea level persists.
An upper air cyclonic circulation lies over Saurashtra & neighbourhoodat 5.8 km above mean sea level.
